name: YTDLnis
tagline: Save video or audio from almost any link
description:
YTDLnis downloads video and audio from more than a thousand websites. Share a link to it from your browser or any other app, a small card pops up, and you pick MP3 or video and the quality you want before it starts.

Under the hood it drives yt-dlp, so it can do the fiddly things: queue downloads and schedule them for a certain time, work through whole playlists, cut a clip by timestamp or chapter, skip SponsorBlock segments, and embed subtitles, chapters and cover art. There is a built-in terminal for your own yt-dlp commands, an incognito mode that keeps no history, and it can use your cookies to fetch videos only your account can see.

Needs Android 7 or newer. Video sites change constantly, so a download that worked last week can break until yt-dlp is updated, which the app can do from its own settings.
